news.title: JEE Advanced 2026 Registration & Eligibility Criteria Released
news.college_name: National Testing Agency / IIT Joint Board
news.summary: IIT Joint Admission Board announces the schedule for JEE Advanced 2026 with revised top 20 percentile cutoff guidelines and online mock test portals.
news.content: Candidates qualifying JEE Main within the top 2,50,000 ranks are eligible for registration. Examination centers will span across 220 domestic and 8 international cities.

news.title: IIT Madras Retains #1 Position in NIRF 2026 Overall Category for 8th Consecutive Year
news.summary: Ministry of Education unveils NIRF Rankings 2026. IIT Madras clinches top spot in Overall and Engineering categories with unmatched research output.
news.content: Scoring 89.42 points, IIT Madras leads national peers in patent filings, deep-tech incubation startups, and industrial placement average CTCs.

news.title: TNEA 2026 Engineering Counselling Final Allotment Round Announced
news.college_name: Anna University, Directorate of Technical Education
news.summary: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE) releases Round 3 seat allotment for Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions across 440+ affiliated colleges.
news.content: Candidates must confirm their provisional allotments before the reporting deadline. Over 92,000 engineering seats were successfully allocated in general quota.

news.title: UGC Approves Simultaneous Dual Degree Programs Across Central Universities
news.summary: New regulatory framework allows undergraduate students to pursue two full-time academic degree programs simultaneously in physical + online mode.
news.content: Designed to encourage interdisciplinary proficiency across engineering, data science, humanities, and management.

news.title: IISc Bengaluru Launches India's First Quantum AI Research Center with ₹120 Cr Grant
news.summary: State-of-the-art quantum computing laboratory established in collaboration with leading enterprise semiconductor leaders to accelerate AI drug discovery.
news.content: Center will offer specialized post-graduate fellowships, high-performance quantum computing clusters, and industry-sponsored PhD seats.

news.title: BITS Pilani Records 100% Placements in Computer Science with ₹32 LPA Average Package
news.summary: Premier private institute completes Phase-1 campus recruitments with 380+ global companies participating and international highest offer touching ₹1.8 Crore.
news.content: Key recruiting partners included Google, Microsoft, Apple, NVIDIA, Goldman Sachs, and emerging generative AI unicorns.

news.title: PSG Tech Achieves NAAC A++ Accreditation with Record 3.82 CGPA Score
news.summary: National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) peer team awards highest grade to PSG Tech praising state-of-the-art industry collaborative centers.
news.content: The autonomous institution demonstrated exceptional outcomes in patent commercialization, student entrepreneurship, and NBA-accredited curricula.

news.title: NEET UG 2026 All-India Quota Counselling Dates Announced by MCC
news.summary: Medical Counselling Committee releases schedule for 15% All India Quota MBBS/BDS admissions across top medical colleges and AIIMS institutions.
news.content: Online choice filling and document verification protocols published for 1,08,000 medical undergraduate seats nationwide.

news.title: UGC Mandates National Credit Framework (NCrF) Across All Universities for 2026 Academic Year
news.summary: UGC gazette notification formalizes academic credit transfers across formal, vocational, and digital learning modes nationwide.
news.content: Students can now accumulate and transfer up to 50% credits between central, state, and premier autonomous colleges via the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) portal.

news.title: NTA Opens CUET UG 2026 Online Application Portal with 28 New Domain Subjects
news.summary: Common University Entrance Test portal goes live for admission into 260+ central, state, and private universities across India.
news.content: New additions include Artificial Intelligence Foundations, Applied Data Analysis, Environmental Biotechnology, and Public Policy.

news.title: Ministry of Education Sanctions ₹4,500 Cr Under PM-USHA Scheme for Higher Education Modernization
news.college_name: Ministry of Education, Government of India
news.summary: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan funds allocated to 180 state universities for smart classrooms, AI labs, and incubation hubs.
news.content: Priority grants awarded to multi-disciplinary education hubs in Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh.

news.title: IIM Ahmedabad Records 100% Placement Season with Average CTC Touching ₹34.8 LPA
news.summary: Premier management institute finishes final placements for PGP & PGP-FABM batches with top global consulting and PE firms.
news.content: Top hiring partners included McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Google with 412 total placement offers.

news.title: AICTE Approves Full Tuition Fee Waiver for Top Rankers in Emerging Tech Engineering Branches
news.college_name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
news.summary: Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) supernumerary quota expanded to 10% in Robotics, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, and Semiconductor engineering.
news.content: Eligible candidates with family annual income below ₹8 LPA can claim 100% tuition waiver across all approved autonomous and government institutions.

news.title: Tamil Nadu TNEA 2026 Engineering Counselling Records 98.4% Cutoff at Top Coimbatore & Chennai Colleges
news.college_name: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Tamil Nadu
news.summary: Round 1 and 2 seat allotment metrics reveal high demand for Computer Science, AI, and Electronics branches in premier state institutions.
news.content: Top filled colleges included CEG Anna University, PSG Tech, CIT Coimbatore, SSN College of Engineering, and GCT Coimbatore.
